limitations.text: Could not inventory warehouses. No labelled examples exist for the AOI (get_examples returned 0). zero_shot_text is not configured. Both imagery sources return 'no imagery source' errors, so there is no visual verification. The only data left is a synthetic 160 m embedding index (idx-001, 3430 cells, whole AOI 136.82-136.92E, 35.05-35.12N). Without seeds or imagery, any ranking would be unsupervised and unable to separate warehouses from factories or other large roofs. I chose 160 m cells because they are about building scale (a 1,600 m2 warehouse is about 40x40 m); Clay's 1280 m cells are too coarse. I did not fabricate points. Area searched: none reviewed with confidence. Area not reviewed: the whole AOI (~70 km2). Count: unknown (range 0 to unbounded; no estimate). A human-labelled seed or working imagery access is needed to proceed.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses (>=~1600 m2 logistics/storage buildings) in AOI near Nagoya port area (136.82-136.92E, 35.05-35.12N), return points with evidence, count range.
known_limits: 10 m embeddings/Sentinel-2 can hardly distinguish warehouses from factories
GSI aerial 0.5 m for visual checks limited to 20 cells per call
understanding.scope: AOI ~9 km x 7.7 km, year 2024. Warehouses only; exclude factories, markets, hangars.
